name: Mini-PC Monthly Security & Maintenance Audit
note: Not auto-imported — this file documents the job. It was created with the command below. --no-agent keeps the LLM out of the path entirely: the script's stdout IS the delivered report, so it cannot be reformatted, summarised or hallucinated. The wrapper at ~/.hermes/scripts/minipc_audit.sh execs scripts/audit.py in this skill.
create_command: hermes cron create '0 6 1 * *' --no-agent --script minipc_audit.sh --name 'Mini-PC Monthly Security & Maintenance Audit' --deliver origin
